createdFor: Gibson/Gibsooon pixel character logo and icon direction

identityReferences: Attached portrait of Gibson smiling in black hat with mountain background.
Attached desk photo of Gibson smiling while working with laptop and stylus.
Attached Watson photo: dark coat, one ear up and one ear flopped, white chest mark, red collar/leash.

globalArtDirection.style: Retro video-game pixel character, chunky 8-bit/16-bit sprite language, square pixel grid, bold simple silhouette, thick clean outline, minimal facial geometry, friendly expression, readable at tiny sizes.
globalArtDirection.noTextRule: No words, no letters, no labels, no signature, no watermark.
gibsonTraits: short light brown hair visible under cap when useful
watsonTraits: one ear standing up and one ear flopped down
250px color version may include a bandana

sizeRules.16: True tiny icon. Extreme simplification, black pixel outline only, transparent background, no fill, no interior detail except the minimum needed to identify the subject.
sizeRules.128: Transparent black-outline icon. Simplified but more recognizable than 16px, no fill, clean pixel outline, minimal interior contour lines.
sizeRules.250: Full color pixel character. Transparent background, thick black outline, flat pixel colors, simple shading, no text.

recommendedPlacements.header: Use the 128px outline icon or 250px color character scaled down when personality is desired.
recommendedPlacements.nav: Use 128px outline icons for menu accents or hover states.
recommendedPlacements.loader: Use 16px or 128px outline icon for a minimal loading sprite; use 250px color only for playful loading moments.
recommendedPlacements.footer: Use 250px color character or duo as a personality anchor.
recommendedPlacements.social: Use 250px color portrait for avatar; use 128px outline for monochrome profile systems.

globalArtDirection.negativePrompt: No text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no background scene, no gradients, no realistic rendering, no anti-aliased vector look, no soft painterly edges, no 3D render, no complex texture, no extra characters, no incorrect dog ear symmetry, no filled color on 16px or 128px outline variants.

generationNotes.transparentHandling: If the active image model cannot generate true transparency directly, generate on a flat chroma-key background and remove the background locally. Keep final PNGs transparent.
generationNotes.sizeHandling: Each requested size has its own prompt. Do not generate one master image and resize for all sizes; the 16px and 128px prompts are intentionally simplified true-icon prompts.
generationNotes.colorHandling: Only 250px outputs should be full color. The 16px and 128px outputs should be transparent with black outline only and no fill.
reviewCriteria: Watson has one ear up and one ear down.
Watson's chest heart is present in 128px and 250px when feasible.
Gibson consistently wears a baseball cap and t-shirt.
250px color versions feel like the same character family.
